dayCalculation: Subtract purchaseDate from requestDate as calendar dates. The purchase date is day 0. Day 30 is included; day 31 is outside the window. Dates in this scenario are valid and requestDate never precedes purchaseDate. Never use the runtime clock or today's date.
missingData: An absent or null purchaseDate, requestDate, or itemCondition is unknown. A known exclusion establishes ineligibility even when another field is unknown. Otherwise missing data requires needs_information.

rules.when: Both dates are known and requestDate is more than 30 calendar days after purchaseDate.
The first rule did not match and itemCondition is opened.
Neither exclusion matched and any of purchaseDate, requestDate, or itemCondition is missing or null.
Both dates are known, the elapsed calendar days are between 0 and 30 inclusive, and itemCondition is unopened.
